provenance.instrument: Harrison Township Zoning Ordinance (Chapter 27 Zoning, Ord. No. 1944 of 11-23-2009, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 HA2349, Township of Harrison, Allegheny County (27-510.11B sends appeals to the Allegheny County Court of Common Pleas, 27-309.11 records plans with the Allegheny County Department of Real Estate). District uses are the Table of Permitted and Conditional Uses in 27-205 and lot and yard figures the table in 27-206, both as text. The only attachments are a plant list and the zoning map. Floodplain rules are in Chapter 8 (Ord. 1968 of 2014). New Laws: Ord. No. 2027 (emergency medical services authority) and No. 2028 (sidewalks, Chapter 21), none on zoning
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 table of contents: 'Includes legislation through 12-22-2025.' New Laws: Ord. No. 2027 (3-25-2026, emergency medical services authority) and Ord. No. 2028 (8-24-2026, Chapter 21 sidewalks and curbs)
checks: The code's accessory unit is a 'Dwelling Unit in Accessory Garage' (27-408.20). It is a special exception in R-1, R-2, R-3, S-1 and V: 'living quarters in an accessory garage as an accessory use to a single-family house to accommodate domestic employees of the residents of the principal building' (27-303.1). The Zoning Hearing Board decides under the Part 4 standards (27-510.5)

27-408.20: at least 500 sq ft of habitable floor area. No unit in a garage basement. A separate entrance that does not pass through an office, a shop or another dwelling unit. 'Accessory dwellings may be authorized only in the residential districts when the applicant can demonstrate a need to house domestic employees of the residents of the principal building.' The unit may not be conveyed unless a subdivision creating a separate lot for it is recorded. Two off-street parking spaces for each dwelling unit
27-408.20D says 'only in the residential districts', while 27-303.1 names S-1 (Special) and V (Village) too. Whether the unit reaches S-1 and V is not settled

'In all zoning districts, no single-family house, two-family house or multifamily house may be converted to contain a greater number of dwelling units.' Converting means remodeling, altering or adding to an existing structure so it has more units. Tearing down a building and replacing it with a new one with more units is not a conversion (27-315)
Up to two nontransient roomers may live in a single-family house by special exception in R-1, R-2, R-3, S-1 and V (27-303.2)

Two-family houses are permitted in R-2, R-3 and V, multifamily houses in R-3 and V, and three- or four-family houses are a conditional use in R-2 (27-205). Lot area per family: 2,500 sq ft in R-2, 2,000 sq ft in R-3 and V (27-206)

A use not named in Table 205 but 'substantially similar to a use listed' may be allowed by conditional use in the district where the listed use is. Other unlisted uses are conditional uses only in M-2, 'except in those cases where such use is determined by the Zoning Officer to constitute an accessory use at the lot in question' (27-204)

Lot and yards (27-206): R-1 8,000 sq ft, 60 ft wide, front 25, side 10, rear 20. R-2 5,000 sq ft, front 20, side 8, rear 20. R-3 and V houses 4,000 sq ft, front 15, side 3, rear 20. No structure, attached or not, may project into a minimum yard (27-206.1B). Height 45 ft unless the Zoning Hearing Board approves more (27-207)
A lot of record held in separate ownership when the chapter took effect may be built on for a permitted use even if smaller or narrower than the minimum (27-206.1C)
Parking: two off-street spaces for the garage unit (27-408.20F) and two for the house (27-305), four in all

Floodplain (Chapter 8): in a floodway, no new construction, substantial improvement or other development unless an engineering analysis shows no rise in flood levels and a DEP permit is obtained. In an AE area without a floodway, no more than one foot of rise, and no new construction within 50 ft of the top of bank without a DEP permit (8-402A, B)
Variances: 27-510.4. No bar on a use variance
The minimum gross floor area of a single-family home is 800 sq ft (27-208). It is a rule for the house, not for the garage unit, whose minimum is 500 sq ft (27-408.20A)

A single-family house is 'A detached residential building that is the only principal structure on the lot ... containing one dwelling unit' (27-602). A family includes 'domestic servants or gratuitous guests thereof' (27-602 'Family')
Modular homes, manufactured homes and vacation cottages are a special exception in C-1 (27-303.3). They are principal dwellings, not a second unit on a lot
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Harrison Township Zoning Officer. Read in a browser on eCode360 (print view), one page at a time, on 2026-11-16. Read: Part 2 (27-201 to 27-209, Table 205 and Table 206), 27-301 to 27-309 in Part 3, 27-315, 27-408 (with 27-408.20), 27-510, Part 6 (27-601, 27-602), Chapter 8 sections 402 and 601, the New Laws page and code searches (ADU terms, 'Dwelling Unit in Accessory Garage', floodplain). Table 205 prints its permitted and conditional columns interleaved, so each use was placed by its section reference: the conditional uses cite Part 4. Not read: Part 1, Part 4 outside 27-408, 27-310 to 27-317 except 27-315, the rest of Part 5, Part 7 and the rest of Chapter 8.

term.note: 'Dwelling Unit in Accessory Garage' (27-408.20). 27-303.1 lists it as 'living quarters in an accessory garage as an accessory use to a single-family house to accommodate domestic employees of the residents of the principal building'. A dwelling unit is 'One or more rooms for living purposes, together with separate cooking and sanitary facilities, used or intended to be used by one family' (27-602)

status.note: A special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board, under the 27-303.1 listing and the 27-408.20 standards

status_outside.note: C-1, B-1, M-1 and M-2 do not list the garage unit. C-1 allows a single-family house only by conditional use

status_by_form.note: 'In all zoning districts, no single-family house, two-family house or multifamily house may be converted to contain a greater number of dwelling units', and converting includes 'an addition to' an existing structure

path.note: 'The following uses may be authorized with such conditions as are deemed appropriate by the Zoning Hearing Board' (27-303). The Board applies the Part 4 standards, including 27-408.20

fallback_path.note: Zoning Hearing Board, on the usual findings. No bar on a use variance

unlisted_use_path.note: Board of Township Commissioners. 'Any use unnamed in Table 205 of this Chapter but substantially similar to a use listed in Table 205 shall be available in the same district as such listed use by way of a conditional use.' Other unlisted uses are conditional uses only in M-2, unless the Zoning Officer finds the use is an accessory use at the lot

unlisted_use_scope.quote: Any use unnamed in Table 205 of this Chapter but substantially similar to a use listed in Table 205 shall be available in the same district as such listed use by way of a conditional use

value.name: Two-family house (R-2, R-3, V)
value.conditions: Two-family houses are permitted in R-2, R-3 and V (27-205). Lot area 5,000 sq ft and 2,500 sq ft per family in R-2, 4,000 sq ft and 2,000 sq ft per family in R-3 and for houses in V (27-206). An existing house may not be converted to more units (27-315), so this is a new two-family building. Two parking spaces per unit (27-305)
value.note: A new building of two units, not a unit added to a house. Replacing a house with a new two-family building is not a conversion under 27-315

building_types.note: An accessory use 'to a single-family house', which is a detached building (27-602)

value.condition: The unit may house only domestic employees of the residents of the house, and the applicant must show a need to house them.

The unit is in an accessory garage on a lot with a single-family house. The garage may be existing or new. A unit in a garage basement is not permitted. A free-standing cottage that is not a garage is not this use.
The unit needs a separate entrance that does not pass through an office, a shop or another dwelling unit.
The unit may not be sold or conveyed apart from the house unless a subdivision creating a separate lot for it is recorded under this chapter and the subdivision ordinance.

In an identified floodplain area (Chapter 8), a floodway allows no new construction, substantial improvement or other development unless an engineering analysis shows no rise in flood levels and a DEP permit is obtained. In an AE area without a floodway, no more than one foot of rise is allowed, and no new construction or development within 50 ft landward of the top of bank without a DEP permit.

districts_read_no_listing.note: Table 205 lists no living quarters or ADU for these districts

districts_in_doubt.note: 27-303.1 names S-1 and V, but 27-408.20D allows the unit 'only in the residential districts'. 27-202 calls S-1 'Special' and V 'Village', not residential

types_allowed.note: 'Dwelling Unit in Accessory Garage' (27-408.20), 'living quarters in an accessory garage' (27-303.1). The code does not require the garage to exist already, so a new accessory garage built with the unit in it is read as allowed. Detached new here means only that

value.detached_new: Dwelling unit in a new accessory garage
value.garage_conversion: Dwelling unit in an existing accessory garage
value.over_garage: Dwelling unit above the parking floor of an accessory garage

min_sqft.note: 'Dwelling units shall have a minimum habitable floor area of 500 square feet.' The 800 sq ft minimum in 27-208 is for a single-family home, not this unit

max_height_ft.note: 'No structure shall exceed 45 in height above average ground level unless approved by the Zoning Hearing Board.' It reaches every structure, an accessory garage too

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: 'All structures, whether attached to the principal structure or not, and whether open or enclosed ... shall not project into any minimum front, side or rear yard.'

family_only.note: No family rule. The unit is for domestic employees of the residents, which is an occupancy rule

occupancy.value: Domestic employees of the residents of the house, where the applicant shows a need to house them

spaces_required.note: 'Two off-street parking spaces shall be provided for each dwelling unit.'

total_on_site.note: Two for the house ('Single-family house ... 2 per dwelling unit', 27-305) and two for the garage unit
